---

mode: unified

this workflow-instance node will add the document nodes into the main workflow, but mark them with:

- hidden (no component)
- temporary (not saved)

during load, it will find the internal workflow input and output nodes and add edges to itself to connect it's hidden internal handles.

during execute it will route changes to its internal and outer inputs cross over and send to the correct outputs

external inputs => internal outputs => wf input node
wf output node => internal inputs => external outputs

---

mode: isolated

this workflow-instance node will create it's own instance of the workflow store and engine and hook up to the runtimeStates of the wf input and output nodes

external inputs => wf input node runtime state + data trigger
wf output node => runtimeState wfCallback => this runtime state + data trigger 

the engine run state and speed can be modified independently (or they can just read from a global observable)
